//: WHAT: typechecks the Jest suites under supabase/tests, which the root
WHY:  the whole-app review's finding #31 — these four suites ran
UNTYPECHECKED. They are the mirror tests that pin the client's
notification kinds and categories to the migrations, so a drift they
exist to catch could be introduced by a type error in the catcher.
A SEPARATE config rather than deleting the root exclude: these files
legitimately read the filesystem, so they need @types/node — and
adding 'node' to the ROOT types would make fs and path importable
from src/, in a React Native app where they do not exist at runtime.
That is the exact mistake that sent the EXIF guard to scripts/.
⚠️ THREE of the review's five, not five. push.test.ts and
emailContent.test.ts both import modules under supabase/functions,
which is DENO — npm: specifiers, Deno.serve, URL imports — and tsc
cannot read them without a Deno-flavoured config of its own. Pulling
push.test.ts in here produces errors about the module under test
rather than the test, which is noise, not coverage. Those two stay
untypechecked and the reason is now written down.
RUN:  npm run typecheck (which runs this too), or npm run typecheck:tests.
